signals.classification: CONFIRMED FORGOTTEN-SIGNAL RECOVERY; PAID BETA CAPABILITY
signals.changed: The Claude Messages API can now compact a conversation on demand. A separate request returns one signed compaction block that replaces the summarized history; the request can run in the background while the conversation continues, and recent turns can remain verbatim after the summary.
signals.free_value: No additional orchestration or compaction product fee is listed. The capability is part of normal Messages API access, but both the compaction sampling step and later model calls are token-billed.
signals.approximate_value: The primary value is avoided orchestration work and repeated context replay. If 100,000 old tokens become a 5,000-token block, each uncached continuation avoids roughly 95,000 input tokens—about $0.19 at Claude Sonnet 5 list price. Actual savings depend on summary size, caching, model, and number of later turns.
signals.cash_required: Paid API billing is required. At Claude Sonnet 5 list rates, compacting 100,000 input tokens and emitting a 2,000-token summary is roughly $0.22 before any extra thinking or overhead; a bounded validation can use a $1 ceiling.
signals.eligibility_reality_check: Available through the first-party Claude API on supported Claude models using the compact-2026-09-04 beta header. It is not available through Amazon Bedrock or Google Cloud. No startup, incorporation, funding, geography, or team-size gate, but an API account with billing is required.
signals.why_asymmetric: It converts long-session continuity from custom summarization code into a signed, provider-recognized state primitive. That directly supports B₂ROOT semantic resume, checkpointed agents, and ICE experiments while allowing work to continue during background summarization.
signals.catch: This is beta and lossy: a summary is not full replay. The compaction request must use the same model used for summarization, is billed like another inference request, cannot be combined with context_management in the same request, and must complete before the original conversation exceeds the model window. A misplaced or edited signed block produces errors or loses continuity.
signals.window: Available since September 14, 2026; no published expiry, but the beta header and request shape may change.
signals.immediate_exploit: Use one synthetic 50,000–100,000-token B₂ROOT-style transcript. Compact only older turns, keep the last exchange verbatim, cap spend at $1, and compare continuation accuracy, effective input tokens, total billed tokens, and checkpoint size against the uncompacted baseline.
